references.text: Eleazar, Aaron's son, is mentioned as a priest with special duties related to the sanctuary.
Offerings were to be brought outside the camp to maintain the camp's purity.
Unclean persons and things were sent outside the camp to preserve the boundaries of holiness.
The sin offering was burned outside the camp, a parallel to the red heifer.
The unclean were sent outside the camp so as not to make the camp where the Lord dwells unclean.
Jesus suffered outside the city gate, paralleling how the sin offering animals were burned outside the camp.
